definitions.explanation: A category of fish with bluish backs, including mackerel, sardines, saury, and horse mackerel. Known for being rich in omega-3 fatty acids.

examples.japanese: {青魚|あおざかな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Blue-backed fish are good for your health.

examples.japanese: {青魚|あおざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{食|た}べられない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: You can't eat blue-backed fish as sashimi unless it's very fresh.

examples.japanese: {青魚|あおざかな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧DHAやEPA⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: Blue-backed fish are rich in DHA and EPA.

examples.english: Adding ginger when simmering blue-backed fish removes the fishy smell.

notes:
A culinary and nutritional category rather than a strict biological classification. The name literally means "blue fish" and refers to fish whose backs appear blue or silver-blue. These fish are a staple of Japanese cuisine and are frequently discussed in health contexts.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧: mackerel
- {鰯|いわし}: sardine
- ⟦{秋刀魚|さんま}→秋刀魚：13756_sanma⟧: Pacific saury
- {鯵|あじ}: horse mackerel
- {鰤|ぶり}: yellowtail

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青魚|あおざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: blue-backed fish sashimi
- {青魚|あおざかな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: simmered blue-backed fish
- {青魚|あおざかな}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: allergy to blue-backed fish
- {青魚|あおざかな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: not good with blue-backed fish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白身魚|しろみざかな}→白身魚：21114_shiromizakana⟧: white-fleshed fish (sea bream, flounder, etc.)
- {赤身魚|あかみざかな}: red-fleshed fish (tuna, bonito, etc.)
- {光り物|ひかりもの}: shiny/silver-skinned fish (sushi term, overlapping category)
